de495e443cbde950.en: The package contains fictional rows for “child A” (the subject of the request), “child B” and “child C”. There is no basis for disclosing B’s or C’s data to this applicant.
de495e443cbde950.zh: 材料包包含虚构的“儿童A”（请求对象）、“儿童B”和“儿童C”记录。没有向该申请人提供B和C数据的依据。

4a6145279d45c8d9.en: Inventory of the prepared data export
4a6145279d45c8d9.zh: 已准备导出数据的清单

ff9098624caf75bc.en: Received by the controller on {{received}}. The request concerns one child; the representative’s authority and the request details have been verified. Information on processing and access to the child’s data have been requested.
ff9098624caf75bc.zh: 数据处理者于{{received}}收到。请求涉及一名儿童；代表权限和请求要件已核实。申请人要求提供处理信息并查阅与该儿童有关的数据。

1ca8cbf118680d26.en: Verification of representation is complete. This record confirms the recipient’s identity but does not authorise disclosure of information about other children.
1ca8cbf118680d26.zh: 代表权限核验已完成。该记录确认收件人身份，但不授权披露其他儿童的信息。

1cdac61cadcc01c4.en: The right to access one’s own data and protection of other people’s information must both be respected.
1cdac61cadcc01c4.zh: 必须同时保障查阅本人数据的权利和保护他人信息的要求。

8e2dd56c96f503cb.en: Refuse access to individual data because the whole file is confidential.
8e2dd56c96f503cb.zh: 因整个文件保密而拒绝提供个人数据。

408e53a062a34792.en: Release the entire file because the representative’s authority has been confirmed.
408e53a062a34792.zh: 代表权限已确认，因此提供整个文件。

bc5f4370be961699.en: Provide information and access relating to child A, excluding other children’s data unless there is a basis for disclosure.
bc5f4370be961699.zh: 提供儿童A的信息及查阅机会；无披露依据时，不包含其他儿童的数据。

ee93148929a02eeb.en: How should a proper individual response be prepared?
ee93148929a02eeb.zh: 应如何准备适当的个别答复？

179027b4492234be.en: Confidentiality and completeness of the response are separate requirements.
179027b4492234be.zh: 保密和答复完整性是不同的要求。

67e9573bcacc52b4.en: An export containing only child A’s data arrived, but it omitted the requested purposes and legal bases of processing.
67e9573bcacc52b4.zh: 收到的导出文件仅包含儿童A的数据，但缺少申请人要求的处理目的和法律依据。

cc466308aabcb446.en: Check and complete the remaining items; providing a row does not mean the request has been fully fulfilled.
cc466308aabcb446.zh: 核查并补齐剩余事项；提供一行记录不代表已完整履行请求。

34b9e272c2d906b1.en: Close the request once other people’s rows have been removed.
34b9e272c2d906b1.zh: 删除他人记录后就结束请求办理。

1aaa526569a31641.en: Restore other people’s rows instead of providing legal bases.
1aaa526569a31641.zh: 恢复他人记录，以此替代法律依据。

ae15690798b44fe5.en: Such a request must be fulfilled within ten working days of receipt by the controller; the response is limited to the represented person’s rights.
ae15690798b44fe5.zh: 此类请求应在数据处理者收件后十个工作日内履行；答复范围限于被代表人的权利。

3e4ea97c7b9c3352.en: Every data-related matter is considered only within thirty calendar days.
3e4ea97c7b9c3352.zh: 任何数据问题都只适用三十个自然日的办理期限。

9f1aeda99a1b4910.en: Entry in the register starts a new independent period after receipt of the request.
9f1aeda99a1b4910.zh: 收到请求后，在登记簿登记会启动一个新的独立期限。

a64e8dd6ec970b89.en: Find the controller’s time limit for fulfilling a valid representative’s request when no extension applies.
a64e8dd6ec970b89.zh: 查找未适用延期时，数据处理者履行代表人合规请求的期限。

7d0675936458cb32.en: I asked what information about my child is processed and why. They want to send a table for the whole class in response. I asked for my own child’s data.
7d0675936458cb32.zh: 我询问处理了孩子的哪些信息以及处理目的。他们却打算回复全班表格。我要求的是自己孩子的数据。

5dc5989469d0cd28.en: An ordinary complaint under Federal Law No. 59-FZ
5dc5989469d0cd28.zh: 依据第59-FZ号联邦法律提出的普通投诉

2801aca919829106.en: A public-information request under Federal Law No. 8-FZ
2801aca919829106.zh: 依据第8-FZ号联邦法律提出的公开信息请求

9e8e1e5244595ed3.en: A request to the controller by a data subject or their representative under Federal Law No. 152-FZ
9e8e1e5244595ed3.zh: 数据主体或其代表依据第152-FZ号联邦法律向数据处理者提出的请求

3feea15f3e5bbb89.en: Yes, the evidence is already in the restricted internal part of the case file.
3feea15f3e5bbb89.zh: 是的，证明材料已存放在案卷的受限内部部分。

2a35928d79ff2ac1.en: There is no need to request the documents again in a public chat.
2a35928d79ff2ac1.zh: 无需在公开聊天中再次索要文件。

64454ee2649c1bb1.zh: 是否已核实法定代表权限？

82b8a9378bbf61b6.en: One row for my child and rows for all the other children.
82b8a9378bbf61b6.zh: 一行是我的孩子，其余是其他孩子的记录。

f49a93086a5ad808.en: The combined file contains other data subjects’ information.
f49a93086a5ad808.zh: 合并文件包含其他数据主体的信息。

698f741d5a45db8f.en: What is included in the prepared export?
698f741d5a45db8f.zh: 准备好的导出数据包含哪些内容？

14d8238bc5f6ca20.en: The purposes and bases of processing, the information I requested about my child, and an opportunity to inspect the child’s data.
14d8238bc5f6ca20.zh: 处理目的和依据、我请求提供的孩子信息，以及查阅孩子数据的机会。

a88f08975fb3c5e0.en: You are preparing the controller’s response to a verified legal representative. You are not acting as a supervisory authority and must not forward the request to Roskomnadzor instead of fulfilling the controller’s duty.
a88f08975fb3c5e0.zh: 你正在为数据处理者准备给已核实法定代表人的答复。你并非监督机关，不能用向俄罗斯通信、信息技术和大众传媒监督局转交请求来代替数据处理者履行义务。

8e900c7114d4c026.en: Reception office of a municipal authority acting as data controller
8e900c7114d4c026.zh: 作为数据处理者的市政机关接待处

4118c3d29bdd0989.en: Give the representative the combined table, as to all parents.
4118c3d29bdd0989.zh: 像给所有家长一样，向该代表提供合并表格。

b3603a869033e096.en: Arrange for the controller to fulfil the request through an authorised employee and a secure channel.
b3603a869033e096.zh: 安排由数据处理者通过授权工作人员和安全渠道履行请求。

111529e0f63ec40e.en: Forward everything to Roskomnadzor instead of responding as the controller.
111529e0f63ec40e.zh: 将全部材料转交俄罗斯通信、信息技术和大众传媒监督局，而不由数据处理者答复。

bdc4f0081425a3bc.en: Information about the child, not the whole class
bdc4f0081425a3bc.zh: 孩子的信息，而非全班信息

72f8f712aad4970e.en: Provide the whole table for convenience.
72f8f712aad4970e.zh: 为了方便，提供整张表格。

b4d9fc2174b3eb0a.en: Representation defines the relevant rights but does not open access to other children’s data.
b4d9fc2174b3eb0a.zh: 代表权限确定可行使的权利范围，但不允许访问其他儿童的数据。

10c539072fb6629f.en: Assistant: “Verified representation allows every record in the same table to be released.”
10c539072fb6629f.zh: 助手：“代表权限核实后，就可以提供同一表格中的所有记录。”

0e385c79539f3681.en: The controller received a valid request
0e385c79539f3681.zh: 数据处理者已收到合规请求

14f68dcaa26c5853.en: An excessive data export has been prepared
14f68dcaa26c5853.zh: 准备的导出数据超出了必要范围

b282a752366df728.en: An individual controller response within the special time limit, without substituting referral for fulfilment.
b282a752366df728.zh: 由数据处理者在特别期限内作出个别答复，不以转交代替履行。

c73d0677d6580225.en: Compare access before and after signing in
c73d0677d6580225.zh: 比对登录前后的访问情况

865ee4d1a4d3b155.en: Check the confirmed recipient list and the basis of processing
865ee4d1a4d3b155.zh: 核查已确认的接收人名单及处理依据

9df9098141c03aef.en: Limit the conclusion to the particular service examined
9df9098141c03aef.zh: 将结论限于已核查的具体服务

4e378da1d7151528.en: Explain the actual conditions and how to report a fault to the representative
4e378da1d7151528.zh: 向代表说明实际情况及故障报告方式

50a79e97618e54ae.en: Keep the verification materials and respond to new access information
50a79e97618e54ae.zh: 保存核查材料，并对新的访问信息作出回应

39a043dbc04bb58b.en: Ask for the password to be sent to unrelated employees for checking
39a043dbc04bb58b.zh: 要求将密码发送给无关员工进行检查

aeab6f7992d4415f.en: Publish the child’s record to test users’ reactions
aeab6f7992d4415f.zh: 公开儿童记录，以测试用户反应

7c0da42b0f7abe6c.en: A similar screen on a website is not the same as a public publication: the access mode and recipients change the conclusion.
7c0da42b0f7abe6c.zh: 网站上的相似界面不等于公开发布；访问方式和接收人不同，结论也不同。

071fdb352050ecce.en: Training check: the record is unavailable without authentication; the legal representative sees only their own child; authorised employees are limited by their work duties. The materials verify the processing basis and proportionality to its purpose. An unrestricted audience has not been established.
071fdb352050ecce.zh: 教学核查：未经登录无法访问记录；法定代表人只能看到自己的孩子；授权员工范围受工作职责限制。材料已核查处理依据及其与目的的相称性。未发现不特定公众可以访问。

9d9a9efb32bd45ef.en: A web address does not imply access without authentication. The report concerns a specific record; its conclusion does not extend to every service in the organisation.
9d9a9efb32bd45ef.zh: 存在网址并不意味着无需登录即可访问。记录针对具体数据，其结论不适用于机构的所有服务。

6c0cc64a0ef34c00.en: The case confirms restricted access, not dissemination to an indefinite audience; the response must address the established processing conditions.
6c0cc64a0ef34c00.zh: 案情确认的是受限访问，而非向不特定公众传播；答复应针对已查明的处理条件。

2236a1da0fc70b99.en: Any information with a web address is public.
2236a1da0fc70b99.zh: 任何带网址的信息都是公开信息。

3ce3affeb770ef91.en: Authentication releases the controller from all data-protection duties.
3ce3affeb770ef91.zh: 设置登录验证后，数据处理者就无需承担任何数据保护义务。

2cd1ecb68440e525.en: Training follow-up. The next day, the representative reports seeing another child’s record after signing in and provides evidence securely.
2cd1ecb68440e525.zh: 教学后续情境。次日，代表报告登录后看到了另一名儿童的记录，并通过安全方式提交证明。

203cd0a0e765260e.en: Record the new access-control failure and send the minimum necessary information to the controller and competent unit.
203cd0a0e765260e.zh: 记录新的访问权限隔离故障，并向数据处理者和主管部门提交最低必要信息。

5a6fb45451b88adf.en: Reject the new information because yesterday’s report showed correct operation.
5a6fb45451b88adf.zh: 因昨天的记录显示正常运行而拒绝新的信息。

4c79ad189457d0cd.en: Suggest discussing the other child’s record in the shared chat.
4c79ad189457d0cd.zh: 建议在群聊中讨论另一名儿童的记录。

444b34f7d26d6fe1.en: Do not classify restricted access as a proven public publication; check the grounds and limits of the actual processing.
444b34f7d26d6fe1.zh: 不将受限访问认定为已证实的公开发布；应核查实际处理的依据和边界。

65d2bc1a650c9461.en: Find the article distinguishing provision of data to specified people from dissemination to an indefinite audience.
65d2bc1a650c9461.zh: 查找区分向特定人员提供数据与向不特定公众传播数据的条款。

eefac672d7c68e9b.en: I saw my child’s health information on the school-service screen and thought the entire internet could see it. I copied the page address, but my neighbour could not open it.
eefac672d7c68e9b.zh: 我在学校服务页面上看到孩子的健康信息，以为整个互联网都能看到。我复制了网址，但邻居打不开。

10ce81e6dd98e13a.en: A sign-in form appears; the table is not visible.
10ce81e6dd98e13a.zh: 显示登录表单，看不到表格。

06183bb664afedc9.en: Public access has not been established.
06183bb664afedc9.zh: 尚未确认存在公开访问。

5be951025a95609a.en: Only my child’s. The internal report confirms this.
5be951025a95609a.zh: 只能看到我的孩子，内部记录也确认了这一点。

81f06e9b2f163934.en: Distinguish access to one’s own record from access to someone else’s.
81f06e9b2f163934.zh: 必须区分访问本人记录与访问他人记录。

a3ecae4d980a9ad4.en: Whose records are visible in your account?
a3ecae4d980a9ad4.zh: 你的个人账户中能看到谁的记录？

25416af8d101210b.en: Only the named employees with access required for their work. The legal basis and purpose are attached.
25416af8d101210b.zh: 只有名单中具备工作所需权限的员工。已附法律依据和处理目的。

fa22534584101760.en: The basis for processing is not limited to publication.
fa22534584101760.zh: 处理依据不限于公开发布。

65fc1c087b41698f.en: Who else has access according to the report?
65fc1c087b41698f.zh: 根据记录，还有谁拥有访问权限？

a89cb9e19f3892dd.en: I want to understand who can see the record and what to do if someone else’s record appears.
a89cb9e19f3892dd.zh: 我想了解谁能看到记录，以及出现他人记录时该怎么办。

a6063392c17714a3.en: An explanation and verification of access boundaries are needed.
a6063392c17714a3.zh: 需要说明并核查访问权限边界。

b283d9a70e63c925.en: Prepare the competent unit’s response about the verified access mode and how to report other people’s records.
b283d9a70e63c925.zh: 准备主管部门的答复，说明已核实的访问方式及发现他人记录时的报告程序。

ca57ff722973cbd4.en: Declare a public leak without confirming accessibility.
ca57ff722973cbd4.zh: 未确认可访问性就宣布发生公开泄露。

0a3d59f10cc39181.en: Refuse any explanation because a password is required.
0a3d59f10cc39181.zh: 因设有密码而拒绝任何说明。

9cf65f8aaff2d83b.en: The table was in my account
9cf65f8aaff2d83b.zh: 表格出现在我的账户中

327ba02b390c110b.en: Restricted access does not rule out permission errors; new information must be assessed separately.
327ba02b390c110b.zh: 受限访问不排除权限错误；新信息需要单独评估。

72cb1f72999de09e.en: A password confirms the lawfulness of every subsequent operation.
72cb1f72999de09e.zh: 设置密码就能证明之后所有操作均合法。

c93539d4668e7db6.en: Assistant: “No public access means no further data complaints are possible.”
c93539d4668e7db6.zh: 助手：“没有公开访问，就不可能再有数据方面的投诉。”

7c7cdf1a245e4686.en: Compare the data listed in the consent and the new demand
7c7cdf1a245e4686.zh: 比对同意书与新要求所列的数据

5da943b690d0e287.en: Verify receipt of the demand and continuing public access
5da943b690d0e287.zh: 核实已收到要求且公开访问仍在持续

0ad70437a8e4c800.en: Prepare an assessment specifically of the continuing dissemination
0ad70437a8e4c800.zh: 专门评估仍在持续的数据传播

330ae98800a305ea.en: Explain how public publication differs from processing on other lawful bases
330ae98800a305ea.zh: 说明公开发布与基于其他合法依据的处理有何区别

40dc609035c4b767.en: Check removal of public copies within the controller’s control
40dc609035c4b767.zh: 核查数据处理者控制范围内的公开副本是否已移除

c55c89cf3477ac32.en: Circulate a copy of the album in the shared discussion
c55c89cf3477ac32.zh: 在公共讨论中传播相册副本

9add55fb163efaaf.en: Demand destruction of all education records without examining their legal bases
9add55fb163efaaf.zh: 不审查法律依据，要求销毁所有教育记录

f422c4c378b452d4.en: The initial consent was valid; the decision changes because a demand to stop dissemination has been received, not because the original signature was defective.
f422c4c378b452d4.zh: 最初的同意有效；处理决定改变，是因为收到停止传播的要求，而非原签名存在问题。

d1a449128599e3d6.en: The original separate consent covered the name and photograph in the album. The controller received the representative’s valid demand to stop disseminating that same data. The materials establish no other basis for public publication.
d1a449128599e3d6.zh: 原单独同意涵盖相册中的姓名和照片。数据处理者已收到代表提出的合规要求，要求停止传播同样的数据。材料未确立其他公开发布依据。

8a6cc755e3c0d8b5.en: Consent and demand to stop dissemination
8a6cc755e3c0d8b5.zh: 同意书及停止传播要求

16c02d2a411ade2d.en: After receipt of the demand, the file remains accessible without authentication. Internal education records are not the subject of the demand.
16c02d2a411ade2d.zh: 收到要求后，文件仍无需登录即可访问。内部教育记录并非本次要求的对象。

8487e8967545376e.en: Check continuing dissemination after a valid demand, without equating it with deletion of all lawful internal records.
8487e8967545376e.zh: 核查合规要求提出后仍持续的传播，不将其等同于删除所有合法内部记录。

9be1b132bd34ff5f.en: Consent once given can never be withdrawn.
9be1b132bd34ff5f.zh: 一旦同意，就永远不能终止。

9eb01248b225f970.en: Stopping publication requires immediate destruction of the pupil’s entire personal file.
9eb01248b225f970.zh: 停止公开发布就要求立即销毁学生全部个人档案。

0796ae497696df3b.en: Training follow-up. The controller closed the original album, but the same file remains in another public section it controls.
0796ae497696df3b.zh: 教学后续情境。数据处理者关闭了原相册，但同一文件仍留在其另一个公开栏目中。

8a393386880008ea.en: Check the second public copy and dissemination of the same data; closing one address does not fully satisfy the demand.
8a393386880008ea.zh: 核查第二份公开副本及同一数据的传播；关闭一个网址并不代表已完整满足要求。

5f4e3495b7ae935c.en: Treat the demand as fulfilled once any URL is removed.
5f4e3495b7ae935c.zh: 只要删除任何一个URL，就认定要求已履行。

4ac228eeb81f54ef.en: Demand new consent from the representative for dissemination that has already been stopped.
4ac228eeb81f54ef.zh: 对已经终止的传播要求代表重新同意。

2b86d77f98d9f20a.en: Check fulfilment of the demand to stop dissemination within its stated scope; do not replace it with destruction of all records.
2b86d77f98d9f20a.zh: 核查是否按指定范围履行停止传播要求，不以销毁全部记录替代。

3aec38d5767d5037.en: I previously gave separate permission to publish my child’s name and photograph. Later I asked for dissemination to stop; the school received the appeal, but the photograph remained in the public album.
3aec38d5767d5037.zh: 我以前单独同意公开孩子的姓名和照片。后来我要求停止传播，学校收到了诉求，但照片仍在公开相册中。

a9d3f350c69f2b3e.en: Separate consent, for the name and photograph. I do not dispute the original publication.
a9d3f350c69f2b3e.zh: 是针对姓名和照片的单独同意。我不质疑最初的公开发布。

f2e12848341a6356.en: The change in the legal basis is being checked, not the original form.
f2e12848341a6356.zh: 核查的是依据发生的变化，而非原表单。

4190bc856efadef8.en: I identified myself, my relationship to the child, my contact details and which data must no longer be disseminated. Receipt is confirmed.
4190bc856efadef8.zh: 我写明了本人身份、与孩子的关系、联系方式以及不得继续传播的数据。已确认收件。

d57a7a7fb382cbd0.en: The scope of the cessation demand is defined.
d57a7a7fb382cbd0.zh: 停止传播的对象范围已明确。

76b9ec162d285541.en: How is the new demand documented?

246c7873c02dd839.en: The controller refers only to the earlier consent in the materials; no other basis is given.
246c7873c02dd839.zh: 材料中数据处理者仅援引之前的同意，未提供其他依据。

123271746bb192bc.en: The earlier signature does not replace assessment of the new demand.
123271746bb192bc.zh: 旧签名不能替代对新要求的评估。

12e065cb780d9c88.en: Is there another basis for publication?

2e00fe7c1edd4778.en: No, only dissemination of the name and photograph in the public album.
2e00fe7c1edd4778.zh: 不是，只要求停止在公开相册中传播姓名和照片。

1325f731a786dedc.en: Stopping dissemination is not the same as destroying every record.
1325f731a786dedc.zh: 停止传播不等于销毁任何记录。

9449206b85dce927.en: Are you asking for all school records to be deleted?
9449206b85dce927.zh: 你是要求删除学校的所有记录吗？

bf9a89b369950a2a.en: Prepare a review of the continuing dissemination by the competent unit; separately inform the controller of the demand’s scope.
bf9a89b369950a2a.zh: 准备由主管部门审查持续传播行为，并单独告知数据处理者要求的范围。

23195158b8106ec4.en: Refer only to the original signature and end the work.
23195158b8106ec4.zh: 仅援引原签名就结束办理。

e66a851bb0ad1749.en: Order destruction of all school records regardless of the grounds for retaining them.
e66a851bb0ad1749.zh: 不考虑保存依据，下令销毁所有学校记录。

642d87bac37d4c6e.en: Processing for other purposes and on lawful bases is assessed separately from public dissemination.
642d87bac37d4c6e.zh: 基于其他目的和合法依据的数据处理，应与公开传播分开评估。

c88d8fddb26f8490.en: Destroying all data is easier than distinguishing the legal bases.
c88d8fddb26f8490.zh: 销毁全部数据比区分法律依据更简单。

3551f6331fe3bb33.en: Assistant: “Stopping dissemination means the school may no longer retain any data about the child.”
3551f6331fe3bb33.zh: 助手：“停止传播意味着学校不能再保存孩子的任何数据。”

fda6a41aa7a693ab.en: General consent and consent to dissemination are not the same.
fda6a41aa7a693ab.zh: 一般处理同意与传播同意并不相同。

678a949099a5cd3a.en: Raise the need to check the basis for dissemination
678a949099a5cd3a.zh: 提出核查传播依据的必要性

a8297631b450dc8a.en: So that parents can check the information themselves.

3858f1460d1ea558.en: Post the original list in the shared chat

beea491c71fb221c.en: Without consideration by the competent authority.

0ab6262b27dec03e.en: Fine the school on behalf of the reception office
0ab6262b27dec03e.zh: 以接待处名义对学校罚款

dbe20ab21c7909e1.en: Do not promise penalties or removal of all copies on behalf of other authorities.
dbe20ab21c7909e1.zh: 不得代表其他机关承诺处罚或删除所有副本。

b144084ca1ebc41e.en: Explain the next steps to the applicant
b144084ca1ebc41e.zh: 向申请人说明后续程序

56df7ad103f32223.en: Use an anonymised working copy; necessary originals go only to authorised recipients.
56df7ad103f32223.zh: 使用去标识化工作副本；必要原件仅提供给获授权的接收人。

e03d6318fc129394.en: Do not publish her attachments in a publicly accessible case card.
e03d6318fc129394.zh: 不得将她的附件发布在公众可访问的案件卡中。

a98a9268355fbb76.en: Check the complaint’s registration and the included materials
a98a9268355fbb76.zh: 核查投诉登记及材料组成

5046b06180e0d456.en: Do not send the complaint only to the party whose actions are challenged.
5046b06180e0d456.zh: 不得只将投诉转给被投诉的一方。

db488fbc40430857.en: Prepare referral to the appropriate competent authority
db488fbc40430857.zh: 准备转交有相应管辖权的机关

cc561889a8fd2cc7.en: Record confirmed actions; do not treat the case as resolved merely because it was forwarded.
cc561889a8fd2cc7.zh: 记录已确认的行动，不因已经转交就认定案件已解决。

a5974b1607ed2f25.en: Keep monitoring notification and receipt of the materials
a5974b1607ed2f25.zh: 继续跟踪通知及材料接收情况

5368b139e7b9894b.en: The written complaint has been accepted. “Northern School” is fictional. Documents show only placeholder fields, with no real children’s information. The player does not upload actual medical documents.
5368b139e7b9894b.zh: 已受理书面投诉。“北方学校”为虚构机构。文件仅展示占位字段，不含真实儿童信息。玩家不上传真实医疗文件。

81814ed5f4ad1038.en: The complaint is registered. Calculate the general response deadline; the scenario includes no extension.
81814ed5f4ad1038.zh: 投诉已登记。请计算一般答复的截止日期；题设未适用延期。

71bfb9329cb07a7e.en: Health information requires examination of special processing grounds; a general reference to consent is insufficient.
71bfb9329cb07a7e.zh: 对健康信息必须核查特别处理依据；笼统援引同意并不足够。

6248cd7fec6df056.en: The child’s health information is publicly accessible. A general consent form does not authorise all dissemination; the basis and scope must be checked.
6248cd7fec6df056.zh: 儿童健康信息可以被公众访问。一般同意表格并不授权任何传播；必须核查依据和范围。

f1bf67525db47782.en: The plan for transferring the sensitive attachment does not restrict access to it.
f1bf67525db47782.zh: 敏感附件的转交计划没有限制其访问权限。

c0f3c9a9eaf79a75.en: Training statement: “Consent to processing was signed on enrolment; we do not provide a separate document for dissemination.” This is a participant’s position, not proof that publication is lawful.
c0f3c9a9eaf79a75.zh: 教学陈述：“入学时签署了处理同意，我们不提供单独的传播同意文件。”这是参与者的立场，并不能证明公开发布合法。

b4a6cdc17c7b3076.en: Training mock-up: “Pupil A — medical-group information”; “Pupil B — preventive-vaccination information”. There are no real names or diagnoses here. In actual document handling, originals are sent through a secure official channel only to the authorised recipient.
b4a6cdc17c7b3076.zh: 教学示例：“学生A——医疗分组信息”；“学生B——预防接种信息”。这里没有真实姓名或诊断。实际文书办理中，原件应仅通过安全公务渠道发送给获授权的收件人。

f590496c8be943fe.en: Check the specific basis for processing and dissemination. General consent does not replace separate consent to dissemination.
f590496c8be943fe.zh: 必须核查处理和传播的具体依据。一般同意不能代替单独的传播同意。

89f161f93896e730.en: Since general consent was signed, publication must be lawful.
89f161f93896e730.zh: 既然签署了一般同意，公开发布就一定合法。

30ef7347726e6974.en: Is there a proper legal basis specifically for disseminating this data?
30ef7347726e6974.zh: 是否存在专门支持传播这些数据的适当法律依据？

b7d3e14af87eefc5.en: Medical information stops being personal data once published.
b7d3e14af87eefc5.zh: 医疗信息一经公开，就不再属于个人数据。
